name: joint_v3_effb0_20260906

metrics.harness: scripts/eval_inria.py (pooled IoU, 25 official val tiles) and scripts/eval_india_osm.py (CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, 142 OSM footprints)

repeat_run_noise.note: joint_effb0_20260905.pt and this checkpoint are, as far as the surviving artifacts show, two executions of the SAME configuration — identical epoch size and training loss to four decimals over 46 epochs, best_val_iou differing by 7e-6. Treat the pair as a noise estimate, not a comparison: Inria reproduces to ~0.0001 while the Bangalore figures move ~0.02 (pixel recall 0.460 vs 0.443, footprint recall 0.369 vs 0.390, silent 0.546 vs 0.560). An Indian difference under 0.02 from one run means nothing. A claim that one of them trained on 16 tiles rather than 103 could NOT be substantiated — no such training log survives in the repo.

limitations: Detects 1.28x the OpenStreetMap reference area in Bangalore, and OSM's incompleteness means that cannot be verified as correct.
Bangalore precision 0.347 breaks the ~0.49 that every other model scores there, so the extra area is not simply unmapped buildings.
Recall by size is erratic — the 200-500 m2 band regressed (0.462 -> 0.231) while 0-50 m2 improved.
